evidence.excerpt: COMMITMENT TO RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT (“R&D”) ... in 2025, this investment was about HK$1.93 billion (2024: HK$1.92 billion). ... With a global workforce of more than 2,200, the Group operates several R&D centres worldwide across Asia, Europe and the Americas serving SEMI and SMT.

notes: R&D headcount, down from more than 2,400 a year earlier. The FY2025 sentence drops the words 'R&D' that the FY2024 one carries, and an earlier pass held this row rather than infer the cohort. An independent review closed the inference with a second disclosure: the same report states on p20 that total group headcount was about 9,000, so 2,200 cannot be the whole company and can only be the R&D cohort the surrounding paragraph describes. Relation is gt because the source says 'more than'. A second reviewer supplied the stronger proof: the FY2024 report's equivalent sentence is the same template with the word kept — 'With a global R&D workforce of more than 2,400, the Group operates several R&D centres worldwide' — so FY2025 dropped a word from a recurring sentence rather than describing a different population. That is textual, not arithmetic.

evidence.excerpt: As of 31 December 2025, the total headcount for the Group was about 9,000, excluding about 1,600 flexi workers and outsourced workers. Of the 9,000, approximately 700 were based in Hong Kong, 4,000 in mainland China, 900 in Singapore, 1,000 in Germany, 700 in Malaysia, 400 in Portugal, 300 in the United Kingdom, and the rest in other parts of the world.

notes: Total group headcount, explicitly excluding about 1,600 flexi and outsourced workers, which are deliberately not registered. Relation is approx because the issuer writes 'about'. This is the figure that establishes the R&D cohort at ASMPT-RD-HEADCOUNT-2025 is a subset and not the whole company.

evidence.excerpt: As of 31 December 2025, the total headcount for the Group was about 9,000, excluding about 1,600 flexi workers and outsourced workers. Of the 9,000, approximately 700 were based in Hong Kong, 4,000 in mainland China, 900 in Singapore, 1,000 in Germany, 700 in Malaysia, 400 in Portugal, 300 in the United Kingdom, and the rest in other parts of the world.

notes: Mainland China headcount: approximately 4,000 of a group total of about 9,000, the largest single location by some distance and ahead of Germany, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Portugal and the United Kingdom. Directly relevant to the question this atlas exists to answer -- the thermocompression-bonding incumbent employs more people in mainland China than anywhere else, alongside the Shenzhen manufacturing and RMB714m Shanghai R&D subsidiaries recorded in the entity notes. Relation is approx; the issuer writes 'approximately'. The other six named locations are on the same sentence and are not registered here.
